title: The walk home
text: Two older boys stop him on the walk home from school and want his bag. Nobody else is on the street.

choices.text: He swings at the bigger one.
choices.outcome: He gets a black eye and keeps the bag. The older boys leave him alone after that.

choices.text: He runs, all the way home, faster than he knew he could.
choices.outcome: They never catch him. He starts running everywhere after that, just because he can.

choices.text: He hands the bag over and says nothing at home.
choices.outcome: It happens again the next week, and the week after. He gets very good at being quiet.
